reserveReview.rationale: The ACRDX live-reserve producer is the single-asset chronicle-nav adapter: it reads the Chronicle VAO Poked NAV for the token and publishes exactly one exposure, labelled "Apollo Diversified Credit Fund NAV", at 100%. The reviewed composition previously carried the Chronicle feeder-level category split (Apollo Diversified Credit-I Fund shares 97.11%, cash 2.73%, unidentified cryptocurrency 0.16% as at 2026-07-27, re-confirmed on the live dashboard 2026-08-08), so no reviewed row matched the captured exposure by name and the whole 34%-weight slice compiled without an assetClass or a failure domain. The composition is restated at the granularity the producer actually captures, matching the shape used for every other single-asset NAV adapter in the registry and for the identical Apollo fund under acred-apollo-securitize. The exposure is a fund share on the Apollo Diversified Credit Fund, held through the Anemoy Capital SPC feeder; the feeder's own category split is the look-through recorded above, and the fund's obligor-level schedule is not published, so the aggregate row keeps a basket-needs-split disposition rather than asserting a resolved obligor list.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Chronicle Proof of Asset NAV for ACRDX as captured by the production chronicle-nav single-asset adapter (one 100% exposure), interpreted with the Chronicle-verified gross feeder-fund holdings reconciled to ACRDX NAV at the 2026-07-27 attestation and re-opened 2026-08-08
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The captured exposure is a single unsplit fund NAV. Within it, Chronicle reports the feeder-level categories (Apollo Diversified Credit-I Fund shares 97.11%, cash 2.73%, cryptocurrency 0.16%) but identifies neither the USD 70,838.76 cryptocurrency balance's token, nor the cash counterparties, nor the ~USD 39,473 gross-holdings-to-NAV difference, and the Apollo fund's obligor-level schedule is not published at all. The whole NAV row is therefore carried as an unsplit basket.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The exposure is an identified Apollo fund share rather than a Pharos-tracked stablecoin dependency, but it is captured as one aggregate NAV whose underlying obligor schedule is not published. The Chronicle feeder categories are recorded in knownUnknownExposure; they are not a per-obligor split, so the row stays explicitly unsplit.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The underlying Apollo fund filing names BNY Mellon Trust as custodian, but the feeder-level custodian, provider shares, segregation terms, and rehypothecation policy are not public. The BVI segregated-portfolio structure supports structural bankruptcy separation without proving custody-level segregation.
